description: Defines the AAudioServiceEndpoint class used for communication with audio hardware or ports in the Android AAudio system. Includes method declarations for stream management, position retrieval, and configuration.

classes.name: AAudioServiceEndpoint
classes.description: Represents an endpoint for audio service communication, managing streams and hardware interaction.

methods.name: ~AAudioServiceEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of the endpoint state.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the audio stream with specified request parameters.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Performs cleanup before deleting the stream.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers a stream with the endpoint.

methods.name: unregisterStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream from the endpoint.

methods.name: startStream
methods.description: Starts the given stream and provides a client handle.

methods.name: stopStream
methods.description: Stops the given stream.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Starts a client; default implementation returns AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Stops a client; default implementation returns AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.

methods.name: standby
methods.description: Puts the endpoint into standby; default returns AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Exits standby mode; default returns AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.

methods.name: getFreeRunningPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current position and timestamp of the audio stream.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the time when the frame was presented to hardware.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: getRequestedDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the requested device ID.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the configuration matches the endpoint.

methods.name: getOpenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of open streams.

methods.name: setOpenCount
methods.description: Sets the open stream count.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is connected.

methods.name: getAudioAttributesFrom
methods.description: Extracts audio attributes from parameters.

methods.name: releaseRegisteredStreams
methods.description: Releases all registered streams.

methods.name: isForSharing
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is shared.

methods.name: setForSharing
methods.description: Sets whether the endpoint is shared.
